headline: The matcher hypothesis is dead (0 recoverable misses, twice). The live coverage estimand is not stable enough to run an improvement loop against: two runs at identical parameters read 0.4505 and 0.1923.

step_1_baseline_reconfirm.intent: Re-confirm the 0.4505 number on the same 20 docs, seed 0, same fixed judge before changing anything.
step_1_baseline_reconfirm.graph_changes_between_runs: none — no resolve, no re-extract, no structured re-run
step_1_baseline_reconfirm.code_changes_between_runs: 113 pure insertions to audit_recall.py, 0 lines touching coverage_for_doc / fact_key / triple_keys / gkeys / resolve_surface (git-verified)
step_1_baseline_reconfirm.interpretation: Both runs had FULL judge availability (0/20 unavailable), so this is not the empty-judge defect fixed earlier. It is assertion-level nondeterminism at temperature 0.0: the judge emits a different assertion set per call, and both the numerator and the denominator move with it. A -0.2582 swing on identical inputs is ~9x the +0.03 movement threshold this campaign uses to decide whether a fix worked.

queue: A: canonical-ID normalization in the coverage matcher (match-side)
B: fixed assertion replay (deterministic replay of accepted assertions to separate matcher from extractor misses)

rejection_evidence.method: Built a LOOSE surface index over every surface an entity id can wear (canonical name + all aliases + the raw id + id_map preimages; 959 entities, 88 id_map entries) — a strict superset of what the matcher keys. Replayed each recorded miss against it. A miss absent even there cannot be recovered by ANY keying change.
rejection_evidence.control: Replaying the graph's own 869 triples through the same loose index returns 869/869 = 1.0000, and through the production matcher returns 813/813 = 1.0000. The index is sound, so a zero result is evidence and not a bug.
rejection_evidence.conclusion: matcher_recoverable = 0 in BOTH independent runs. Canonical-ID normalization has a provable ceiling of +0.0000 on this estimand. Implementing it would have been knowingly doing work with a measured-zero effect.
worked_examples: evolves_into_lore Clefairy->Clefable and Gloom->Vileplume: no triple with that subject+predicate exists at all (absent class) — only re-extraction recovers these.

allied_with Blaine->{Erika,Brock,Yellow,Sabrina,Koga}: the graph HAS blaine allied_with {team_rocket, misty, lt_surge}. Subject and predicate key correctly; the extractor simply chose different targets (different_object class), not a keying failure.
originates_from {Zorua,Zoroark,Vullaby,Mandibuzz,Rufflet,Braviary}->Unova: Unova-region Pokemon asserted from a Unova list page sitting inside the KANTO unit. Corpus composition, not extraction.

step_2_hypothesis_choice.note: B was also the next hypothesis the H1 trail itself recorded: 'capture one complete seed-0 judge assertion set and replay it as a fixed audit fixture'.

what_landed: audit_recall.loose_surface_index(entities, id_map) — every surface an id can wear.
audit_recall.classify_misses(misses, triples, surfaces) — splits misses into matcher_recoverable / different_object / absent, with samples and a note.
miss_attribution block on every unit report and on the overall report.
Replay-fixture persistence: a live run now writes data/_build/recall/<domain>/<unit>.assertions.json with the accepted assertion set.
step_3_the_change.what_did_not_change: Nothing in the matching path. 113 insertions, 0 lines touching coverage_for_doc, fact_key, triple_keys, gkeys or resolve_surface. This change CANNOT move the coverage number by construction — it explains the number instead of altering it.

determinism_proof.verdict: PASS — byte-identical across repeated provider-free replays. Future iterations can attribute movement to the graph alone.

step_4_per_predicate.note: run_a vs run_b, clean estimand. Both directions swing hard and predicates appear/vanish entirely, which is the instability itself rather than any change in the graph.

evolves_into_lore.reason: The landed change cannot affect matching (0 matcher lines touched). In run_b the judge asserted a different evolves_into_lore set over the sampled docs. This is the same nondeterminism that produced the -0.2582 overall swing, and it is precisely why the watch cannot be evaluated against a live judge.

step_5_movement_rule.threshold: +0.03 on the clean estimand, no regression of healthy predicates
step_5_movement_rule.reason: The change is a measurement instrument with a git-verified zero footprint on the matching path. The observed delta is judge variance.
step_5_movement_rule.decision: CLOSE. No second iteration. A second iteration would be run against a metric whose run-to-run noise (0.2582) is ~9x its own decision threshold (0.03) — the exact error that produced the H1 trail's two unreadable iterations.

honest_final_number.live_estimand: UNSTABLE — 0.4505 and 0.1923 on identical inputs; do not quote a single live figure
honest_final_number.statement: Kanto clean extraction coverage is 0.1923 against the frozen seed-0 assertion fixture, well below the 0.6 gate. Earlier figures (0.3598 from the broken-judge H1 trail, 0.4505 from the first fixed-judge run) are not comparable to it and not comparable to each other.

where_the_gap_actually_lives.statement: 78% of misses have no triple for that subject+predicate at all; the remaining 22% have the relation with other targets. Zero are keying failures. The lever is extraction, not matching.

next_lever: Extraction, measured against the frozen fixture so movement is attributable. The 49 'absent' misses cluster on relation predicates the structured pass under-emits (evolves_into_lore, rival_of, partners_with, appears_in, governs). Before any further coverage work, decide whether the estimand should be scored against a fixed assertion fixture by default rather than a live judge — a metric with 9x its threshold in noise cannot gate anything.
deviations: Step 1 could not re-confirm the baseline: the same command on the same inputs returned a materially different number. Reported as the primary finding rather than papering over it by picking one run.

The prescribed hypothesis A (canonical-ID normalization) was rejected on measured evidence rather than attempted. Implementing a change with a proven +0.0000 ceiling would have burned a provider run to confirm a predicted no-op.
The scoped re-measure doubles as the fixture capture, so only one live provider run was spent for both.
The evolves_into_lore healthy-predicate watch registers a regression that the landed change provably cannot have caused; it is reported as unattributable rather than as a pass or a failure.
No gate was weakened. The 0.6 minimum is unchanged and the audit still reports FAIL.

gates.audit_recall_suite: 17/17 PASS (4 new miss-attribution tests incl. a loose-index control)
